tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search products across online stores. Returns title, price, merchant, source, rating, product URL and a direct checkout URL when available.

tools.name: compare_products
tools.description: Compare prices, ratings, and merchants for a product query across available stores. Highlights the lowest-price and top-rated options.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_products" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
